test_cases.title: A new record is added, listed, kept after reload and removed
acs: DERIVED: Create, read and delete work on Manage Countries, Manage External Test Consultants, Test Types, Test Result Items, Test Method Items, Category Items, Criterion Items
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134). The database has a backup.
Cleanup: the test removes every record it created (names start with E2E and end with the run id), even when it fails.
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.

steps.action: Open the list page of the row from Home > its section.
Type a unique name in the add form and click Add.
steps.expected: The page reloads without an error.

steps.action: Find the new record in the list (use the pager if needed) after reloading the page.
Click Remove on the record.
Reload the list and look for the record.
steps.expected: The record is no longer listed.

test_cases.title: A record can be renamed and the new name is kept
acs: DERIVED: Update works on Manage Countries, Manage External Test Consultants, Test Types, Test Result Items, Test Method Items, Category Items, Criterion Items
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134). The database has a backup.
Cleanup: the test removes every record it created (names start with E2E and end with the run id), even when it fails.
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.

steps.action: Open the list page and add a record with a unique name.
Click Edit on the record.
Type a new unique name and click Save.
steps.expected: The page reloads without an error.

steps.action: Reload the list and look for the new name.
Look for the old name.
steps.expected: The old name is not listed.

test_cases.title: A country that already exists cannot be added twice
acs: DERIVED: Adding a country with an existing name shows "This country already exists" (ManageCountries.aspx.vb:121)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134). The database has a backup.
Cleanup: the test removes every record it created (names start with E2E and end with the run id), even when it fails.

steps.action: Open Manage Countries.
Add a country with a unique name.
Add a country with the same name again.
steps.expected: A message says the country already exists.

steps.action: Reload the list.
Cleanup: remove the country.
